title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our graduate course on Embodied Intelligence and Robot Learning, today's lecture is on Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Recent surveys such as Survey on Evaluation of L-L-M-based Agents and World Model for Robot Learning show growing interest in agents that act over time and models that anticipate how environments change. This paper brings those threads together around the complete robot system. Researchers from The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Fudan University contributed. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们这门具身智能与机器人学习的研究生课上，今天的讲座主题是迈向智能体机器人：模型、数据、环境与驾驭。最近的综述，比如《基于大语言模型的智能体评估综述》和《机器人学习的世界模型》，都显示出人们对能随时间行动的智能体以及能预测环境如何变化的模型越来越感兴趣。这篇论文把这些线索围绕完整的机器人系统整合到了一起。来自香港中文大学和复旦大学的研究人员参与了这项工作。好，诺亚？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what does “agentic” mean here, beyond a robot that can act on its own?
segments.zh: 教授您好，这里的“智能体化”除了指机器人能自主行动之外，还有什么含义？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It describes how a robot system organizes decisions: selecting and coordinating capabilities, using observations and feedback to adjust plans, and checking what happens during execution. It does not necessarily mean the robot operates without people. The paper’s central motivation is that a capable action policy alone may not complete a long task reliably. A robot may also need to notice failure, gather more evidence, choose a different skill, or recover from its current state.
segments.zh: 它描述的是一个机器人系统如何组织决策：选择并协调各项能力，利用观察和反馈来调整计划，以及在执行过程中检查发生了什么。这并不一定意味着机器人脱离人来独立运行。这篇论文的核心动机是，一个能力很强的动作策略本身可能不足以可靠地完成一项长任务。机器人可能还需要察觉失败、收集更多证据、选择不同的技能，或者从当前状态中恢复过来。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors offer a survey and conceptual framework, not a new robot model or controlled experiment. Their taxonomy groups agentic robotics into 4 domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Together, these describe what a robot learns and does, how its experience is prepared, how its tasks and worlds are created, and how capabilities are organized at runtime. The framework helps connect research that often appears in separate literatures, from policy learning to simulation and tool use.
segments.zh: 作者提供的是一篇综述和概念框架，而不是一个新的机器人模型或受控实验。他们的分类体系把智能体机器人划分为4个领域：模型、数据、环境和运行框架。这四者共同描述了机器人学什么、做什么，它的经验如何准备，它的任务和世界如何创建，以及能力在运行时如何组织。这个框架有助于把通常散落在不同文献中的研究联系起来，从策略学习到仿真和工具使用。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: are those 4 domains separate parts of a robot system?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：这四个领域是机器人系统中彼此独立的部分吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not necessarily. The 17 categories are non-exclusive functions, so one system can span several domains. Model includes training, perception, planning, robot control, and adaptation. Data covers collection, annotation, and refinement. Environment includes reconstruction, task generation, and benchmarking. Harness covers orchestration, memory, monitoring and recovery, skills, infrastructure, and layered systems. Think of the taxonomy as a map of responsibilities, not a prescription for a particular architecture.
segments.zh: 不一定。这17个类别是非排他性的功能划分，所以一个系统可以横跨多个领域。模型领域包括训练、感知、规划、机器人控制和自适应。数据领域涵盖采集、标注和精炼。环境领域包括重建、任务生成和基准测试。框架领域涵盖编排、记忆、监控与恢复、技能、基础设施和分层系统。把这个分类体系看作一张职责地图，而不是对某种特定架构的规定。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The Model domain asks how evidence becomes action: an agent might decide what to perceive, decompose a task, check whether a plan is feasible, or revise a policy after experience. Data connects execution to later learning through collected trajectories, added labels, and quality control. Environment design matters because a scene, task, or evaluator can each be flawed in different ways. A physically unstable scene, impossible goal, or misleading success metric can undermine a result.
segments.zh: 模型这个领域要回答的是：证据如何变成行动。一个智能体可能会决定该感知什么、把任务拆解开、检查某个计划是否可行，或者根据经验去修正策略。数据则通过收集到的轨迹、补充的标注和质量控制，把执行和后续的学习连接起来。环境设计之所以重要，是因为场景、任务或评估器各自都可能以不同的方式出问题。一个物理上不稳定的场景、一个不可能实现的目标，或者一个有误导性的成功指标，都可能让结果站不住脚。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what the Harness adds if the system already has a planner and a robot policy?
segments.zh: 如果系统里已经有规划器和机器人策略了，那Harness到底还加了什么价值？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The Harness makes those capabilities usable together. Orchestration routes tasks among models, tools, skills, policies, and sometimes people. Memory stores task state or past experience, while monitoring checks progress and initiates recovery when something goes wrong. Infrastructure supplies interfaces and runtime safety checks. Layered systems divide responsibility across components, such as a high-level planner and a lower-level controller. Without these connections, a good planner may issue a request that its executor cannot safely carry out.
segments.zh: Harness 让这些能力能够协同使用。编排负责在模型、工具、技能、策略，有时还有人之间分配任务。记忆存储任务状态或过往经验，而监控则检查进展，并在出问题时启动恢复。基础设施提供接口和运行时安全检查。分层系统把职责划分到不同组件上，比如高层规划器和底层控制器。没有这些连接，再好的规划器也可能发出执行器无法安全完成的请求。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the key is not just choosing an action, but verifying its physical result?
segments.zh: 所以关键在于，不只是选一个动作，还要验证它在物理世界里的结果？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The paper emphasizes that a tool’s report of success may not prove the intended outcome occurred. Independent checks can use sensor readings, visual evidence, task-specific conditions, or runtime constraints. Plans should also be checked before execution and revised when observations contradict assumptions. Memory needs similar scrutiny: a procedure that worked before may be stale after objects or scenes change. These checks make feedback useful for both immediate recovery and future improvement.
segments.zh: 完全正确。这篇论文强调，工具报告成功并不一定能证明预期结果真的发生了。独立检查可以借助传感器读数、视觉证据、任务特定条件或运行时约束。计划在执行前也应该经过检查，当观察结果与假设矛盾时要及时修正。记忆也需要类似的审视：之前有效的流程，在物体或场景变化后可能已经过时。这些检查让反馈既能用于即时恢复，也能用于未来的改进。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For real-world use, this framework suggests that robot systems need to coordinate perception, action, and verification under changing conditions. A household robot, for example, might recognize that an object has moved, update its plan, select another skill, and confirm that the requested placement succeeded. The survey also reports results from individual studies illustrating how infrastructure matters: one cited study found that smaller action steps raised zero-shot success from 60% to 82%. Those figures are not a unified comparison across systems.
segments.zh: 在实际应用中，这个框架意味着机器人系统需要在不断变化的条件下协调感知、行动和验证。比如家用机器人可能发现某个物体被移动了，于是更新计划、换一个技能，并确认所要求的放置是否成功。综述还列举了一些单项研究的结果，说明基础设施有多重要：其中一项被引用的研究发现，把动作步长调小，零样本成功率从60%提升到了82%。这些数字并不是跨系统的统一对比。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How should we interpret those reported results when the studies use different tasks and setups?
segments.zh: 当这些研究采用的任务和设置各不相同时，我们该如何解读所报告的结果呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: As evidence about particular design choices, not as a leaderboard for the field. The paper also cites a comparison where changing an interface reduced question-answering accuracy from 74% to 59.1%. That illustrates how interfaces can affect performance, but differences in tasks, tools, observations, retries, and human assistance make direct cross-study rankings unreliable. A careful evaluation should report those conditions and isolate, where possible, the contribution of planning, tool selection, or recovery beyond the underlying robot policy.
segments.zh: 这些结果应被看作关于特定设计选择的证据，而不是整个领域的排行榜。论文还引用了一项对比：仅仅改变界面，就把问答准确率从74%降到了59.1%。这说明界面确实会影响表现，但任务、工具、观测、重试次数以及人工协助上的差异，使得跨研究的直接排名并不可靠。严谨的评估应当报告这些条件，并在可能的情况下，把规划、工具选择或恢复能力相对于底层机器人策略的贡献单独分离出来。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The same caution applies when moving from simulation to physical robots. Simulation enables repeatable tests and scalable task generation, but may expose precise state or clean success labels that are unavailable in reality. Physical systems face uncertain perception, calibration differences, contact, latency, and actions that may continue after a stop request. The authors therefore treat real-robot testing as a distinct challenge. Strong evaluations should test changing scenes, missing information, executor failures, and dependencies across longer tasks.
segments.zh: 从仿真迁移到实体机器人时，同样需要保持这种谨慎。仿真能实现可重复的测试和可扩展的任务生成，但可能提供现实中并不存在的精确状态或干净的成功标签。实体系统则要面对不确定的感知、标定差异、接触、延迟，以及发出停止指令后仍可能继续执行的动作。因此，作者把真机测试视为一项独立的挑战。严谨的评估应当测试场景变化、信息缺失、执行器故障，以及更长任务中的依赖关系。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this system-level view connect to the V-L-A and world-model surveys?
segments.zh: 这种系统层面的视角，跟V-L-A和世界模型的综述有什么联系？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Surveys of V-L-A models and world models examine important capabilities for linking language, perception, action, or predicted futures to robot behavior. This paper asks how those capabilities are selected, coordinated, checked, and improved within a larger system. Its contribution is a shared vocabulary for studying the interfaces between models, data, environments, and runtime software. That perspective can help researchers identify whether a failure comes from the policy itself or from how the system prepared, executed, or evaluated its work.
segments.zh: 关于V-L-A模型和世界模型的综述，考察的是把语言、感知、动作或预测的未来与机器人行为连接起来的重要能力。而这篇论文问的是，这些能力在一个更大的系统里是如何被选择、协调、检查和改进的。它的贡献在于提供了一套共享词汇，用来研究模型、数据、环境和运行时软件之间的接口。这个视角能帮研究者判断，一个失败到底来自策略本身，还是来自系统准备、执行或评估工作的方式。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The framework also points toward research questions rather than claiming a single best design. Researchers need better ways to isolate an agent’s contribution, validate automatic changes to skills or models, refresh stale memory, and connect high-level reasoning safely to physical execution. Benchmarks should make assistance, tools, observation access, and retry limits visible. Overall, the paper shifts attention from whether a model can produce an action to whether the whole robot system can select, execute, verify, and revise it. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 这个框架指向的是一系列研究问题，而不是宣称某一种设计最优。研究者需要更好的方法来分离智能体自身的贡献、验证对技能或模型的自动修改、刷新过时的记忆，以及把高层推理安全地接到物理执行上。基准应该让辅助、工具、观测权限和重试限制都变得可见。总的来说，这篇论文把注意力从“模型能否产生一个动作”转向了“整个机器人系统能否选择、执行、验证并修正这个动作”。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手或者留言评论。
